reviews.title: Finally, vegetarian - friendly fine dining!
reviews.text:
We are not foodies, so were quite careful about choosing a fine dining spot in Lima to make sure we don’t pay and leave hungry. This surpassed every hope and expectation! 

Beautiful location, lovely atmosphere, attentive and knowledgeable staff who give great recommendations, and food…oh wow, I’ve never been so impressed before, literally at every bite! 

As a vegetarian, I’ve struggled with menu options in Peru, but this one knocked it out of the park. How can one make tortellini taste so good? I don’t know! Very impressive, highly recommended.

reviews.title: A great pleasure to eat @ Astrid & Gaston.
reviews.text:
I am still so Amazed I went to this place. ( we were there on 1/08/2026) 

Starting with the ambience and the atmosphere of the restaurant which I enjoyed so much! 

We had a great pleasure eating the food and drinks. The Experience was an Excellent one! 

Astrid was there and was as nice as you can imagine. She came to our table asking what we were ordering. My Son told her that he was having Cuy! She gave him a big hug and thanked him for being so curious about trying a new dish.
At the end of the evening we also had a tour around the 300 historic colonial house + we took some pictures and received so many hugs from the owner. 
More than having a taste of the Peruvian food we also had a trip through history. 

We will definitely recommend to Family and friends.  
We’re going to be back soon!

reviews.title: An unforgettable experience
reviews.text:
We rated the restaurant as very good. The meals were delicious and with excellent presentation. The service was great. Having arrived earlier, we were able to anticipate the time of our reservation. Astrid appeared at our desk and took photos with some people from our group.
To get to the restaurant, we walked through a street that was closed to traffic and was used by many families for leisure. The heat was hellish and only in the shade the temperature was mild.
The sauer pisco is served in a very nice ceramic glass that is available for sale at the restaurant store (very expensive!).
The ceviche was very tasty.
For a group of 8 people, we ordered 4 different desserts to share and everyone tasted each one (some even had a performance to be served).

reviews.title: Beautiful restaurant, nice tasting menu
reviews.text:
The restaurant located in a very pretty building, setup and deco is very beautiful, it catches my eyes immediately. 

We had 10- course tasting menu, the portion is not small, or rather quite big.i love all dishes, they accommodated my friend’s request (avoid raw food) very well.

While I also noticed some area of restaurant it was bit noisy, I’m not sure it’s by luck or something else, my area is so nice and charm. Can’t complain anything. 

If you love food experience, I would like to recommend this one, with tasting menu.

reviews.title: Charming environment, amazing food and drinks
reviews.text: Charming place, authentic, charming, impeccable food as well as drinks. It is suggested to book in advance to pick up the tables of the salons. We did not make a reservation and sat down on the counter. Courteous service and fair prices for what they deliver.

reviews.title: Incredible and lightweight experience
reviews.text: Wonderful lunch, in cheerful atmosphere with impeccable service from the waiter Diego. An unforgettable experience in Lima

reviews.title: Architecture and space are OK, but cooking is....
reviews.text: The space is superb and the architecture is colonial. At first glance, the staff are attentive, but they seem to be too busy to be here. Best of all, I think the food is interesting because the story is a textbook, but there is too much butter in everything. The taste is uncontoured and out of focus. I don't think I'll ever go again.

reviews.title: Expensive but no counterpart.
reviews.text:
We made a family reservation based in the good name of the time of G & A in Colômbia. However in Lima we ordered pepper tuna fish and we didn’t get fish. It was a very poor insignificant piece of fish untasty.
Other point: the bathrooms filthy. 
I am getting aversion of famous restaurants. Thanks.

reviews.title: Astrid & Gaston - Lima/Peru
reviews.text:
We went to Astrid & Gastón as a family and had a simply unforgettable experience. We made an early booking and, since the arrival, we were very well received. The environment is beautiful to live in — elegant, cozy, with lights and colors that make everything even more special.

We were taken care of by Juan Carlo, who was flawless from start to finish. We ordered a Pisco Sour from Maracujá that was sensational. The basket of bread has already begun surprisingly: simply spectacular.

The dishes were wonderful. My husband and I shared Chupe Rice with jumbo salvajes al ajillo limeño y huacatay, which was divine. My stepmother ordered the Raviolis de Alcachofa y Ricotta, also sensational.

Our youngest son received special attention: Juan Carlo brought a pasta with chicken to the milanese that he loved. That care made all the difference.

The highlight of the meal was the desserts — impeccable, creative and delicious.

We highly recommend Astrid & Gastón. A must-see restaurant in Lima, perfect for a memorable gastronomic experience.

reviews.title: Nice local but no parking
reviews.text: The place is very nice but they have no parking. They should let you know when you make the reservation... take your vehicle to a beach that costs S/ 20. We made a reservation for 1pm but we have to wait about 15 min for a table according to the first come, first served. Some dishes were rich but the olive octopus came without olive cream and had no taste... the duck very good!

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text:
Food was cold
The lagoon was frozen and the village only had lagoon. 

The bad-humored boy 

In 2019 we had an unforgettable experience, wonderful however this time, it was very weak

reviews.title: Peru’s Cuisine Taken to Delicious Andean Heights
reviews.text: With all the research I did, Astrid y Gaston kept coming up as something travelers to Lima must experience. Chef Gaston put Peruvian cuisine on the map with his elevated French style technique. I booked months in advance to behold this talent. The building is an older style home with incredible architecture. Just beautiful. We sat in the main courtyard - they provide blankets and heaters if you get cold. My husband and I opted for the à la carte menu and created our own tasting experience. 11 courses later accompanied by lots of drinks and I have to tell you…. WOW. One of the best meals I’ve had in a very long time. Portions are adequate to share without being overly filling. Pricing is very reasonable and the service was wonderful. Don’t miss out on their Sole Ceviche, Nikkei Oysters, Leche de Tigre, Croquettes, Suckling Pig Blue Corn Tacos, Duck Tartare (showstopper), Potato Tortellini (a work of genius), and Coconut Dessert!! I will remember this meal for a lifetime! Mil gracias, Chef Gaston and staff!!

reviews.title: Highly overrated
reviews.text: This restaurant is good for the tourist who eats once and nothing else, unfortunately the bad experience was due to lack of details, the reservation was for a birthday and zero details about it, the very regular food for people we have eaten in other Peruvian restaurants, the 4 dishes we requested had the same flavor and the same bases, the regular service with much delay between plate and plate, even to charge. We were placed near a speaker with very loud Latin and Peruvian music, often had no proper end of background for dinner. There is no parking included, but if valet with prior payment of 20 soles. In conclusion too overrated.

reviews.title: A beautiful setting with excellent service
reviews.text:
A place to see and be seen in Lima, Astrid and Gaston did not disappoint.

Moderately priced by US standards.   We had several small plates to include the scallop, the crab fan, tuna tartar, and jumbo grilled shrimp.   All very good, scallop was superb.

For main course we had suckling pig and fish of the day.   Both were very good although the fish was slightly undercooked.

The service was impeccable and friendly.   Waiter was very knowledgeable.   Big menu ( we opted for à la carte as opposed to tasting menu).   Very good, worth a visit, but fell just a little short of expectations on the overall food experience.  

Dinner for two with 3 cocktails and was $300 with tip.   I would return.

reviews.title: Very worth the visit
reviews.text:
The restaurant is in an imposing and beautiful mansion! In addition, the service and food are impeccable. It is very worth picking up a table in the central part.
At the exit there is a shop with interesting souvenirs. Worth a visit.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Excellent! With that I sum up the place, the decoration, the setting, the dinner and above all, the Service! All very attentive!

reviews.title: Good place
reviews.text:
From the entrance a spectacular experience, as the Attention and Mood of the place make the dinner wonderful. The Chapel with music gives a tone to the day that is unparalleled. 
The food was a bit due, because we did not like it, because we did not find the dishes or the flavors, because the fish were not what we had thought or what we wanted to taste in this restaurant that is characterized by its good food.
The slightly excessive price, for what we have to eat.

reviews.title: I loved
reviews.text: Just wonderful! Immaculate care and divine food. The Mood is very nice and would definitely come back.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text:
Dinner at Astrid & Gastón was an extraordinary experience. The restaurant, installed in the beautiful Casa Moreyra, impresses from the arrival: elegant Mood, impeccable service and a cuisine that combines Peruvian tradition with contemporary touches of high gastronomy.

The dishes are sophisticated and creative, with authentic flavors and perfect presentations. The tasting menu is a true journey through the flavors of Peru, accompanied by an excellent list of authors' wines and cocktails.

The service deserves highlight: attentive, kind and full of details. And I also had an unforgettable surprise: I was presented for being my birthday, a delicate gesture that made the evening even more special.

⭐ Note: 5/5
A memorable dinner at one of the best restaurants in Latin America.

reviews.title: Not worth the hype or the money
reviews.text:
We were so excited to go to this amazing restaurant!  The evening started off well as our wait staff was very nice.  

All the portions were generous for the most part.  The snacks (small bites) were very tasty and our taste buds were beginning to warm up. We had the octopus, special ceviche and short rib pie.  Then had the bone marrow, and scallop which were very good as well. Then came the main courses, which consisted of the trout, catch of the day, duck with rice and shrimp with Ravioli.  They were good at best, but not what one would expect from a restaurant of this caliber.  The catch of the day, the fish or shrimp were not seasoned very well  and the dish was 100% dependent of the sauce, which was “good.” There was a bug in the green foam of ravioli dish.  I showed it to one of the wait staff as it was moving on my finger and squashed it in front of him.  He seemed a bit shocked and told the head waiter. They should have insisted that they take it back or at least comp it.  Nothing of the sort. My daughter did not want to make a fuss, nor should we have had to.  Our teenage son was not feeling well and it was visibly evident as his head was down and I was rubbing his back, nobody asked about him.  In any establishment someone should have asked how he was doing or if there is anything they could do, but not a word.  When we received the bill I noticed that we paid almost 100 soles for three bottles of water.  I didn’t realize that we had that many, nor did I realize that the water was so costly.  For a regular night out the review would be fine, however this was not a regular night out as it was the finale of our amazing trip to Peru.  What we thought would have been the show stopper was just a bit of a dud as this meal cost almost as much as all of the meals we ate throughout the week. For the number 1 restaurant in Peru, this was a big let down.  The food wasn’t bad, but didn’t have the wow factor that one would expect l, especially for the cost and hype.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: I went in with high expectations and maybe that was the problem, but I would not recommend this place to anyone. Yes, it's true, this place is amazing esthetically but that's about it. I dined with my family of 12 which I know isn't easy, but our servers were never on it. They forgot people's drinks and food. We had to request that our water be refilled several times. The appetizers were good, but the entrees arrived lukewarm and lacked flavor. For the price, I was expecting better service and food. Overall, we spent 3 1/2 hours here. Most of it waiting for food to arrive so we could all eat together. In the end we all gave up and ate when we received our plates. It was not a good experience and we all left feeling disappointed.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text:
The place is nice but the patio is open, it is very cold to eat and neither the heat mushrooms nor the blankets solve it.
The food completely disappointing. My recommendation in this case is to choose another place to dine

reviews.title: Spectacular dinner in a beautiful and welcoming Mood.
reviews.text: The location is beautiful. You walk in and see the small chapel but with a magic inside. We walked in and our table was in the main courtyard.  Beautiful place. Attention is A1.  They take care of every detail. The waiters are super skilled and know how to recommend you at all times. The piqueos are which richer. I ordered the cuy, hedgehog, corn tortilla.  The bread basket is the best I've ever tasted in bread. A wonder. My bottom plate the candied duck. A delicacy. La Lucuma for dessert.  Tmb a mixture of delicious flavors!  Recommended!

reviews.title: A perfect venue for perfect service and perfect dinner!
reviews.text: My 3rd visit and got a walk in! Everything was perfect, the staff, the bar and of course the food. The jumbo shrimp was so good I ordered it twice! Yes there are other top end places in Lima now but Astrid y Gaston has a unique energy. I think the prices are very good for such quality & style. There was a sprinkle of star dust as we got introduced to Dona Astrid. It’s a long way from London but I’ll be back!

reviews.title: World-class cuisine, creativity, and ambience, showcasing Perú's diversity of native flora and seafood.
reviews.text: This review is for the tasting menu the evening of September 26, 2025, with house-paired wines.   In short, the cuisine, service, ambiance, and creativity, rivalled meals at three-Michelin-star restaurants in France and Italy. The tasting menu was a gastronomic tour of Perú and the wide diversity of its native flora and seafood.   The restaurant is in a gorgeous and meticulously maintained colonial era mansion, its façade and attached chapel illuminated at night.  The atmosphere had a relaxed elegance, with large round tables spaced widely.  The meal was impeccably paced -- never a rush and no long pauses.    After a welcome cocktail came about 48 dishes --   each on a work-of-art serving implement -- in 16 courses.  The courses were in five groups.  The first four represented Perú's main geographic zones -- the coast, the mountains, and the rain forest, and the area around Lima.  The final group was four different dessert courses, ending with a kids-in-a-candy-store selection from a huge array of chocolates.  Portions were small enough to allow us to enjoy them all without being uncomfortably full.

reviews.title: I'd come back every time
reviews.text: From the reservation (which I had to change) until we left, everyone is extremely friendly.  The place is amazing, an old house, decorated with what the tourist expects.  The ambient temperature was optimal.  Very good cocktails.  The garzones respectful and attentive to the diners.  The sharing tickets were brought in one by one, which gave us time to properly taste each dish.  Main courses came hot and tasted great.  The wine suggested by the sommelier, made a perfect complement.   Dessert is not far behind.   Undoubtedly a world-class restaurant

reviews.title: Fascinating experience for the senses
reviews.text: Upon arriving in Astrid and Gaston, it becomes an experience for all 5 senses, visually it is a wonderful place. The reception was welcoming and friendly (our reservation was at 4pm but we arrived 30 minutes early). The setting has a clear concept of what they want to convey to their diners, but after passing that door, it is a wonderful place in sight, that majestic tree, the Service of the staff, in particular Renzo who was the one who attended us that Friday afternoon, making the experience pleasant and answering our questions. A place we will certainly go again. The dishes speak for themselves; their quality, freshness and detail make for an unforgettable lunch. Next time we hope to go to dinner.
