reviews.text:
Dinner fine and relaxed. Good and full food. Magnificent decoration. 
The restaurant is in an old mansion of the Moreiras farm. 
Impressive. Perfect Service we pay attention to the waiters and masters. ah is in the pond beautiful pieces to observe and take home.

reviews.title: Dear man! Not worth the experience
reviews.text: Precious for the Service they offer! The menu is at least $250 per Cover. The dishes are good, but the experience is nothing of another world

reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.text: Exceptional food, with an amazing blend of ingredients from Peruvian culture. In fact, a unique gastronomic. Only criticism: my desk was in a Mood next to the gift shop. It had a wind stream and air conditioning that left the place frozen and cooled the food. A couple of Brazilians next to us made the same complaint, but nothing was done. That was the only unpleasant event of the night.

reviews.title: Beautiful experience
reviews.text: Excellent! The food is very good, comes out a bit cold but typical of the country. The place is lovely the service very good. Ideal for day trips

reviews.title: Nice place, hard to reach auqnur, exceptional food, fatal receptionist
reviews.text: The place of the restaurant is very beautiful and... Unfortunately tourists do not stay in that area and it is. Very difficult to arrive for a dinner....traffic is terrible. The receptionist was uncut and understanding when they arrived 15, minutes late and the manager had to leave. Good food and waiter Cesar exceptional in helping us with recommendations!!

reviews.title: Disappointing experience!!!!!!
reviews.text:
We made a reservation to have dinner at Astrid & Gaston with 1 month in advance.  
Upon arrival we were seated on a table right next to the kitchen.  A TOTAL lack of respect and consideration for people who come from another country to spend their money at A&G.  The food wasn’t that great, drinks were ok, service was ok … 
A total disappointment!!!

reviews.title: Problems with the latch in bathroom
reviews.text: I went to the restaurant today. The food was very delicious and the Service was excellent. However, the bathroom had no water, even for washing hands, and most worryingly the door latch was broken. I was trapped in the bathroom for more than five minutes and only managed to get out after repeatedly forcing the latch, leaving my fingers red and sore. I think that, in a restaurant of this level, situations like this are completely unacceptable.

reviews.title: An unexpected adventure.
reviews.text:
Last night, we had an unexpected adventure.

During our siesta, we quickly searched for a nice place to enjoy some fine dining. With a little help from AI, we ended up at Astrid & Gastón, a beautiful restaurant in what looked like a small castle, just outside Miraflores.

The evening started off promising, but halfway through the meal, Jeanette suddenly didn’t feel well. She went to splash some cold water on her face, but within a minute, the waiter came to get me — Jeanette had fainted and fallen on the stairs.

With the help of the staff, we carried her to the restroom. A blonde woman stood out for her calm and care. Jeanette asked, “Do you work here?” She smiled and said, “I’m Astrid.” Yes, that Astrid, from Astrid & Gastón. Her husband, Gastón — Peru’s most renowned chef — personally drove us back to our hotel in their car.

He didn’t speak English, and we barely spoke Spanish, but their warmth and kindness spoke volumes.
That night, it wasn’t about the food (though it was exceptional), but about the people behind it.
Love, care, and humanity — and you could taste it in every detail on the plate.
What remains is heartfelt gratitude — and a deep bow to those who nourish with more than food.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: We reserve an “experience” menu without pairing. I recommend, if it is at night, lunch light because it is 15 steps, all full of history, color, flavor and presentation. The staff very attentive to your Service. We had the opportunity to meet Astrid and take our picture! It is a place full of magic and many Peruvian flavors! Recommended for a special occasion.
reviews.review_tip: Cuando se reserva no informan el valor de los menú de experiencias, están entre 900 y 1600 soles.

reviews.title: It's worth it!!
reviews.text: Very special restaurant in Lima, in a beautiful house. Special food is very well presented. We went to lunch and stayed by the tree in the covered garden. Great experience.

reviews.title: Beautiful, Fun, and Delicious Evening With Friends!
reviews.text: Highly recommended visiting this pretty restaurant with delicious menu options. The ambiance is beautiful, infused with colorful paintings and lively decor. We had pre-dinner drinks in the lounge and enjoyed a full meal in the main dining area. Our group shared a few appetizers (gyoza and scallops). We each chose a different entree, and all were delicious. The chocolate bomb was a fun and yummy ending to our meal too. This was one of the highlight to our time in Lima.

reviews.title: Underwhelming and overpriced
reviews.text: The food was terrible and we couldn’t even finish our meal. We had 3 in our group and no one had a dish worth eating. The sauces were bland with no spice and the only thing we tasted was salt. The wait staff was not attentive to us even though we saw many just standing around or setting up tables. We had 3 different waiters  for our 1 hour dinner…they kept disappearing. The meal was definitely overpriced and food underwhelming

reviews.title: The most beautiful and delicious bread basket you could ever imagine — magical surprising delicious and beautiful!
reviews.text: The most exquisite restaurant I e ever been to - the decor, the food, the service. Delicious from welcoming drinks to the multi-hued and flavored breads and probably the most delicious cuy appetizer…

reviews.title: Mediocre Food, Overpriced
reviews.text: On our last evening in Peru we had the tasting menu with wine pairing. Considering the price of 3176 PEN (almost 800€) for two persons we expected the quality of a gourmet restaurant.  However, the food was mediocre at best and many courses were served luke-warm. Not recommended.

reviews.title: Feasting in Lima
reviews.text:
In a beautiful old mansion our gourmet started in Lima. The interior design, with attention to detail up to individually sewn napkins-all simply stunning.
There are exceptional creations of regional dishes. I've chosen the squid angel hair and the swordshells. Both dishes were really delicious and very filling. After our feast, Astrid came to us briefly at the table. The price of the food in relation to the quality, Service and environment=inexpensive.
Hopefully we can also get a reservation in other gourmet restaurants and continue to visit Lima's top chefs.

reviews.title: Phenomenal experience
reviews.text: We were a party of 10-5 tasting menus and 5 a la carte for 5 kids. The food and ambience were outstanding. We all loved the tastings and dishes. Drinks and wine parings were fantastic. The support staff was top notch. I would highly recommend if you are an adventurous foodie-though, even 2 picky kids nearly licked their plates clean! Truly phenomenal!

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful service and the food was delicious! Staff were great about our food intolerances and religious dietary requirements. The best meal we’ve had in Peru so far!

reviews.title: It was due to...
reviews.text:
We went for lunch. 
Very beautiful and exotic place. 
Correct service. 
Great sommelier. 
Food very graceless. 
I knew the Santiago so quiz to know the matrix. 
It was due

reviews.title: Amazing desserts and drinks!
reviews.text: The location is impeccable, the entire staff is exemplary, strive to make the experience unique! Chef Astrid walks between the tables, splashing sympathy, her desserts were impeccable! The criticism is about the salty dishes that come loaded with coentro, so everything has the same taste. The presentation was spectacular, but as you progress in the taste of the dishes, the palate saturates with the coentro and you no longer perceive the distinction from one ingredient to another. Maybe he would come back and not ask for the sequence, just a la carte dishes. Don't stop eating Astrid's chocolates!

reviews.title: Good address in Lima
reviews.text: Very nice setting and refined cuisine, attentive service.Our waitress advised us very well. We tried a little bit of everything but Guinea pig very popular in Peru.

reviews.title: Great food in a spectacular and stylish setting.
reviews.text: In the heart of the San Isidro quarter, the restaurant is located in a wonderful historic building. It has different dining areas inside and a big outdoor covered terrace around a magnificent bar. Inside the rooms are nicely decorated each in a different stule and showcase several pieces of art. Very stylish atmosphere. Food menu is a la carte and the dishes are of very good quality, cooked to perfection. Pisco sour was a touch too sweet for my taste. Wine was (too) expensive (abt 20,00$/glass)

reviews.title: Worth the international fame you have! Worth a visit!
reviews.text: Very beautiful place, mixing in the right way the old and the modern. Peruvian cuisine of excellence, with cordial service. All the dishes ordered were excellent. Just one detail we didn't like: Although we ordered mineral water from a local manufacturer, the waiter "pushes" imported water. Unnecessary and detrimental article to the restaurant name. Result: we did not give the tray to the waiter, as it is not mandatory. I'd come back to the venue, paying more attention to the waitress' service.

reviews.title: The most incredible experience ever!
reviews.text:
Wow wow wow!! Incredible food, service and venue. Delicious food, superb staff who are very attentive. The cuisine is some of the best I’ve ever tasted, so much choice. The sommelier assisted with wine selection, nothing was too much trouble.
A must if you are visiting Mira Flores Lima.
A bucket list experience!

reviews.title: Probably wouldn't recommend
reviews.text: A bit pretentious for some nice, but basic, food and unfriendly wait staff. Would be nice if they stocked the toilets with toilet paper too. You can find nicer restaurants for the same price point or cheaper.

reviews.title: Sorprendente
reviews.text:
I went with a traveling party from Uruguay.
The restaurant is world famous and therefore one goes with high expectation and afraid of the cost (I preferred not to see anything before on the web)
As for the cost, since I mentioned it,comparing camableon Uruguay prices of higher level restaurants arguably is less or equal, in other words it is not expensive.
It is installed in a huge house , with different rooms and places to eat, with some irregularity in terms of the visual comfort of the diner.{ambient music a little loud in some sector .
The menu is varied but you need the advice of the staff to understand it and choose , as well as the cocktails.Without that advice you do not know that you are ordering, generally which is not annoying, it is part of the fun to discover the ingredients.
Very friendly, attentive and not superb staff as sometimes happens when all diners ask questions about the menu.
The bathroom : a whole experience apart, worth visiting , one forgets what its purpose is.

reviews.title: Astrid & Gaston for a great food experience and ambience
reviews.text: Astrid & Gaston restaurant is located in an impressive mansion. Beautiful interior decor. The wait staff was excellent . Brian the Sommelier showed us around which was highly appreciate. The food, presentation and taste was excellent. The only issue was the free range chicken where the sauce was overpowering and was a bit disappointing.  Other than that I would highly recommend this restaurant both for ambience, service and food.

reviews.title: Incredible Meal
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite restaurants in the world. The building itself is absolutely beautiful and the decorations are stunning. The food was all amazing, we couldn’t stop ordering more. This is a foodies must-visit restaurant!

reviews.title: Tasting menu not worth it
reviews.text: We left this restaurant in shock. We paid $900 Australian dollars for our degustación/  tasting menu which was so much more than what we expected. The prices are not on their online menus so I was guided by the internet. Big mistake. Neither of us had paid that much in Sydney or London for a tasting menu. For that price we didn’t feel that our food matched the price tag. There is a lot of food but about 4 out of the 12 small dishes had  a Parmesan foam which we both found heavy and overpowered the meals.  The service however was very good with our waiters being very attentive and the establishment is striking. Overall my experience wasn’t pleasant because of the shock of bill. It is over 850 soles for tasting menu without wine.

reviews.title: I'd go again but I'd order more typical Peruvian dishes, I didn't want a sophistication like what they brought without flavor
reviews.text:
1.- Very nice and welcoming 
2-. I'm not from Peru, but it wasn't hard for us to get there 
3.- excellent service normal waiting time 

The truth is that I intended to eat a rich ceviche but on the recommendation of the waiter, they were very thin cut fish licks without any flavor accompanied by a tasteless algae leaf and later ordered some artichoke ravioli that brought a green foam flavored to nothing , however dessert was an exquisite tiramisu well prepared.
reviews.review_tip: Pedir platos conocidos peruanos no tanta sofisticación

reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: First of all, the restaurant is absolutely stunning. It is an old hacienda built in the 17th century and it is a national monument. Exploring the building was so much fun, but the highlight was the superb service and the food was fantastic. Everything was delicious , we ordered 2 apps and 3 dinners all were excellent. The service was attentive . We really enjoyed this dining experience. Astrid y Gaston is a must stop if you go to Lima, it is so worth it!

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text:
Simply divine! From the entrance , beautiful atmosphere , very welcoming reception .
Beautiful decoration! Staff service veryooo good! The dishes are divine, well crafted and very tasty! Surpreendeu .! Worth the investment! Parabéns

reviews.title: Error in the booking charge. No solution by the Staff
reviews.text:
On April 17, we had dinner in Astrid and Gaston, for which we made a reservation for 21:45 hrs. On that occasion I booked my name with my credit card. We arrived earlier than the reservation (about 8.30pm), waited for a while and then were made to stop by the lounge for dinner. After dinner, we pay with a different credit card. 

Today, when I check my VISA credit card statement, there is a charge from Astrid and Gaston for S/200, which is not applicable, since we pay for dinner with a different card and for an amount over S/200. Apparently the reception staff did not make it known that we did make use of the reservation, and we were charged the reservation guarantee by 2 people, unjustified charge because we did make use of the reservation.

I request by mail and Instagram that someone from your staff contact me as soon as possible to manage the reverse of the amount on my credit card. After 2 weeks I still have no answer, only evasive from the staff. 

Very bad service that makes the visit to the restaurant unpleasant.
reviews.review_tip: Fijarse en el monto que descuentan de la reserva en la tarjeta de crédito.

reviews.title: Lovely experience, regular food
reviews.text: The place is amazing, the experience is worth it, attention 10. The food let me down. An over-seasoned entrance tongue from the start and a duck that was difficult to eat because of condiment abuse. I love flavored food and seasonings but these dishes were inedible. I liked visiting the place by the place. But I definitely wouldn't come back.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Very good! Wonder food well served, beautiful atmosphere and impeccable service. High prices but worth the experience.

reviews.title: Expectations met
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at the restaurant Astrid & Gastón! From the reception to the end of dinner, everything was impeccable. I would like to highlight the exceptional service of the waiter Diego - extremely attentive, polite and professional, made all the difference in our evening.

The decor of the restaurant is beautiful, with a nice atmosphere, elegant and very well cared for. Everything very clean and organized, which reinforces the capricho of the house.

The dishes surprised: impeccable presentation and amazing, harmonious and creative flavors. You can feel the care in every detail.

Congratulations to the entire team for the excellent work. It is definitely a place that I recommend and intend to return!

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: More than good service, I would say an excellent experience, we had a very pleasant time with good music and excellent food

reviews.title: Anniversary and birthday
reviews.text: The location and design is very showy, the service is friendly although the space between tables does not provide the necessary intimacy, it is compensated by the attention that was quick unlike other restaurants. A pleasant and different experience.

reviews.title: Phenomenal experience!
reviews.text:
Great food, stunning space and impeccable service 🙂 this was an unplanned stop, and we did not have a reservation for a table. The staff were very accommodating to see us at the bar, which was totally comfortable and adequate for our dining experience.
Watching the bartender, prepare the prettiest and tastiest Pisco sour I had on my entire trip was fun!
We were regretful that we did not order the chocolate bomb dessert … The people beside us had it, and it looked like an experience in itself.

reviews.title: Food just good. Care was bad.
reviews.text: I always had a great desire to meet this famous Lima restaurant and maybe that was the problem, expectation was high and unfortunately it was not all I expected. Good food is almost a must in Lima. The food was good but not great. Some dishes ordered below the average and I was disappointed by the service, too pressured, it seemed that they wanted me to unoccupy the table as quickly as possible and it became inconvenient at some times. The value within the expected, beautiful environment.

reviews.title: An unforgettable gastronomic experience!
reviews.text:
Astrid & Gastón in Lima represents the pinnacle of Peruvian gastronomy. My visit was simply the best dining experience of my entire stay in Peru.
The elegance of the establishment strikes from the entrance - deep blue walls, carefully selected artworks and beautiful floral arrangements create a sophisticated yet warm atmosphere.
But it's on the plate that the magic really works. Each dish is a meticulously composed work of art. The tartare presented as a nest with its egg yolk in the center was not only visually stunning but also of incomparable flavor. The potato torsada with its rich sauce accompanied by melting filet mignon demonstrates exceptional technical mastery.
The wine list perfectly complements the dishes offered, with precise recommendations that enhance each bite.
The service, attentive without being invasive, lives up to the reputation of the restaurant. I now understand why Astrid & Gastón is among the best restaurants in Latin America. An experience that will remain etched in my gastronomic memory for a long time.

reviews.title: Don’t go
reviews.text:
Well what to say I had memories of CDMX in Polanco but a disappointment coming to this place 
Super pretentious 
Friends of the owner can have their $400 bottle usd on the table but no one else.... 
Super x flavors, very expensive and nothing to see.... A mixture of ridiculousness with pretension and Botox (mask face )
Dessert at $22 usd and tastes like $3 usd capirotada from Mx... 
Sonle... what a shame...

reviews.title: Astrid y Gaston
reviews.text:
Quite honestly, it was very good and under most circumstances, I would have given 5 stars across the board.
Here is why the 1 star rating. During our dining experience, Astrid stopped and greeted 7 of the 8 occupied tables in our dining room, including some photos. She did not stop by our table. It felt discriminatory and it truly ruined the evening.
Our server was excellent for table service.  We did have a minor reaction to a nut allergy, probably from cross contamination. For a high end restaurant with pride in service and experience, a manager should have check on the table. So either the server did not think much of it to tell management or management did not care.
The appetizers (oysters, both scallop dishes, and peking guinea pig) and starters (oxtail gyoza) were excellent. The sea bass entree and duck confit were nicely prepared.  To be fair, the nut allergy started after the first bites of the entree which puts a shadow over the entree experience.

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text:
If it were not for Mr. Aníbal's poor service, I would say the restaurant is impeccable. I almost always praise those who serve us, but in case....
All dishes ordered by the people who were with us were very praised.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text:
You know when your dream is to meet this restaurant, because of the history of Gaston and Astrid, what they represent for Latin American and world cuisine and you book months in advance. And when he arrives in a spectacular house and is served by a friendly waiter at the beginning and who at the end even offers you a coffee. When you order an angus steak and wait for the meat absolutely soft and comes a hard meat and worse a cabbage loaded with gorgonzola that completely neutralizes the taste of the meat. Frustrante. The waiters and sommelier can't serve wine. Fill the cup too much and worse, add during service.  You know, the expensive restaurant is what doesn't deliver. If you pay expensive and leave there absurdly enchanted, the price is a detail. 
We ordered an entry from dust that was with a fatty and acidless sauce. The other entry that was the language of wagyu was perfect. The basket of bread was delicious. And dessert, too.  Another thing: having the reservation does not mean that you will arrive and be served. We had to wait more than 15 minutes to occupy our desk. It was a disappointment . We ate much better at restaurants in Cusco and Lima itself.

reviews.title: A nice dinner
reviews.text:
Nice experience in a stunning place. It is a very nice big house with extensive spaces.
Dinner is according to the dishes.
First of all some are expensive for who they are. Fame passed through here.
The pickets are expensive and they didn't really measure up. We tried the oka shell and the bangkok lime razor.
We tried sole babiche and it was a bit disappointing. Fresh fish and good but nothing else.
Then the Waygu anti-knife language was much better.
The dish we liked the most was the corvina in scales.
As for desserts we tried the rum slime which was very good and the cheesecake good with cheese taste.
Impeccable service and very friendly.

reviews.title: Wonderful restaurant
reviews.text:
In this restaurant, everything is good: atmosphere, food and service.
The entry breads are different and very tasty, but the food is delicious!!
I ate the fish with indescribable potato crust, just trying.
Very, very tasty!!

reviews.title: A pleasant experience.
reviews.text:
The food is delicious and well presented. Good cocktails and delicious breads. 
Very good snack dessert. 
Coffee service should include some chocolate or biscuit. 
The service is good. 
The atmosphere is nice in the courtyard but somewhat bustling and there are no hygienic services on the ground floor. 
In addition, hygienic services are not enough for so many people. 
I find it incomprehensible that a 3/4 litre bottle of water costs more than a pique.

reviews.title: Fabulous tasting menu.
reviews.text: Didn’t disappoint!  The building and dining rooms were gorgeous - a colonial home with a comfortable museum feel. Seatings felt intimate and service was friendly and attentive. Our waiter Jose presented dishes with excellent English, spent time getting to know us, was available to answer questions and an occasional chat. The dishes were innovative with flavorful combinations that delighted.  Come hungry as the tasting menu (14 courses) is a lot of food.  Felt like the price point was right for the food, ambiance and presentation.

reviews.title: Is not worth the visit
reviews.text: We ordered the tasting menu with 13 courses. We were placed at a simple wooden table in the entrance area, overlooking down to the bar. Every guest, coming or going, had to pass our table. The service was impersonal, routine, the program was unwound. The food was OK, but neither was it. We had promised ourselves much more, the price is in no way justified. Two weeks earlier, we had the tasting menu at Nuema in Quito, worlds better, half price. At A&G there were no new taste experiences, many courses were very similar in taste to the preparation, or were dominated in taste by the ingredients. The desserts were rather tasteless and just sweet. Where all the positive assessments come from is beyond our comprehension. Top restaurants play in a different league.

reviews.title: A MUST GO RESTAURANT IN PERU
reviews.text: AMAZING restaurant. Beautiful environment and one of the best food I had in my entire life.  The best restaurant in Lima, according to my experience (tried many). The owner came to the table, she was very nice with us. I will definitely go back.
reviews.review_tip: Book and enjoy it. Amazing food in a beautiful estancia.

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant, we went with my family to dinner and it was an excellent experience, delicious dishes, impeccable attention. It certainly lives up to its record and does not disappoint. We'll be back.

reviews.title: Fully recommended. Visit it
reviews.text: Service with absolute friendliness. Very careful elaborate food, I don't put 5* because the suckling pig was a little dry, the rest of ka spectacular food. They were kind enough not to charge me for the suckling pig. Except that a perfect place to taste dishes that will surprise you.

reviews.title: Amazing place!
reviews.text: Excellent gastronomy, incredible environment, impeccable service. It's worth a visit. We chose ceviche and also tried the famous cuy (pork from India)

reviews.title: Over hyped.
reviews.text:
San Isidro is an incredibly upscale neighborhood and the building is a thoughtful renovation of a colonial mansion. 
Service was excellent and explanations were thorough and in English. 
This restaurant had long been on my short list as it has been touted by many for decades. Perhaps we expected too much. We found the sauces bland and definitely not spectacular. The combinations were way too many in every dish. More showy than tasty. The breads are unique and very good. Same for chocolate souflee dessert. Astrid lives up to her reputation. 
We sat inside which was a mistake. If we ever go back it will be to the courtyard.

reviews.title: Flavors that fall in love
reviews.text: If you want dishes that surprise you in flavors and presentation this is the place. Greeted by Luis who explained each dish and its origin and in a setting that takes care of every detail. Despite its high cost it is certainly worth it

reviews.title: Prices too expensive
reviews.text:
We took the surprise menu, no wine side, only one glass of red wine for me. The food was good, the desserts average, the setting is beautiful. 
My review is quality price at 517 Euro / two people I expect excellence is not the case.
reviews.review_tip: En principe les plats sont une pièce de viande ou poisson avec une sauce, pas de légumes, peu de décoration. Il n'y pas d'effet de surprise.

reviews.title: Mostly good but could consider to lower price by 20-30% to feel more matched with food experience
reviews.text: This is a gem in many ways, the architecture, the service, the atmosphere and most of the food. But it felt like the pricing was a bit too high relative to the food. The overall experience very much deserves the fine dining price, but there is a bit too much overlap of the ceviche based flavors on the tasting menu. Some of the meat dish texture could use some work. About half of the tasting dishes were superb though and at right level.

reviews.title: Peruvian Gaston.
reviews.text: Very nice place some very exotic drinks but it did not reach me. Encarte altogether order a corvina with a few flakes of potatoes of colors truly beautiful in sight, but the protagonist were the desserts that delights!

reviews.title: A waste of precious time
reviews.text: We’ve been looking forward to this restaurant for a very long time. It took a little patience to get reservations and when we finally did, we arrived 15 minutes early. We were required to put down a credit card deposit of $100, just in case we didn’t show.  We were greeted, seated on a smoking porch, and more or less forgotten for a half an hour. No offers of drinks, no updates on seating. The food may be wonderful, but  the service is deplorable. Don’t waste your time!

reviews.title: Excellent food and atmosphere
reviews.text:
To start the house is nice, the terrace lovely, although, as we booked the tasting menu, we sat in the lounge.
The experience was amazing. The 
Really delicious dishes.
We did not order the menu with pairing but we recommended a very good fruity Peruvian white wine that went well with everything. 
The service of Jorge, very good and also we were attended by a very friendly lady, but you can not hear anything, it
that she explained, we ended up asking George again!

reviews.title: Gastronomy experience
reviews.text: I found it a good dining experience, service not strong in restaurants in Lima but spectacular gastronomy 👌

reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text: Fantastic atmosphere, cheerful decoration and with very good vibe, delicious food. Thanks to John for knowing how to advise us so well what to choose and showed us the whole restaurant!

reviews.title: Luxury Food and Experience
reviews.text:
It's one of the best dining experiences I've ever had. 
We went from Chile to meet the restaurant and it didn't disappoint at all. 
The place and its decoration is beautiful, has very similar designs to the Tanta chains, with colors typical of Peruvian culture. 
The service is excellent, they are concerned to assist and serve you at all times. The only thing we found weird was that they charged for the bread they served at the beginning.
The value of food is on average to any Vitacura restaurant in Chile, but the difference in quality of food and service is a hundred times better. 
Additional point is that they have a section where are the books of Gaston Acurio and tableware with which they present the dishes of the menu, I took a book of the Astrid herself that passed by all the tables to meet the diners and take pictures if any requested it.
This is a classic and must in a visit to Lima, definitely would return.

reviews.title: Waiter drunk
reviews.text:
What a bad experience. We came from Mexico very excited already with the tasting reservation because we had been recommended. And indeed the food was good but our experience declined quite a bit from the eighth time when the waiter “Cesar” passed the cups. From that moment on he no longer explained the dishes and what he did, he did it very hastily. We are from Mexico and many dishes and ingredients were different. We would have liked him to explain us well as he did at first.  
Especially at the end when they brought the “Magic Box of Astrid” the waiter did not explain to us what chocolate was that and when we asked someone else to help us explain they could not explain. 
What a bad experience not being able to even know what chocolates to choose because you don't even know what they are.  It was definitely not the experience I imagined, nor one I would recommend.

reviews.title: Everything was great but went downhill pretty fast hill pretty quickly
reviews.text:
We were looking forward to this experience. Everything started great and the first 10 courses we enjoyed pretty well. However everything went downhill pretty fast. Our waitress was pretty intoxicated by then. He kings of explained the rest os the courses really fast and when we try to ask some one else to explain them to us they couldn’t.  
Don’t get me wrong food is good. But for the price you are paying you expect the waitresses to at least be sober and to know all of the meals in the testing menu.

reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
Great location. 
Amazing experience overall, excellent food quality, very good service with attention to every detail.

reviews.title: Evaluate the experience
reviews.text:
The house is very well decorated, service differentiated from the arrival.
Book 3 months in advance. We opted in the booking act by the experience menu, there is no time to change.
Such a menu has a sequence of 15 or 16 small dishes with very variable flavors, 4 of which are dessert. 
These dishes are sometimes exotic, with the use of raw egg yolk, cuy (pork from India), alpaca meat and there goes...
The balance is positive, but I had information that the a la carte menu is better and more on account.
Anyone willing to pay more than $300.00 per person, go ahead.

reviews.title: Incredible experience
reviews.text: Amazing experience for the flavors, care, variety, care. It is fair that Lima is considered one of the world’s gastronomic capitals. Astrid and Gaston contribute to the title being validated.

reviews.title: A delightful, pleasant and amazing food
reviews.text: The restaurant is emblematic for the story of Gaston Acurio who, in short, left to study law, returned to cook and met Astrid, chef patisserie. Next the place: an old facade house, which hides the size for those looking from outside. The environment is divided into several rooms and this is already worth the visit. I sat in the larger lounge and from there you can see the constant movement of the kitchen. The basket of bread is beautiful and the langostino tacos are licking - literally - the fingers. From the main dish, I ate a meloso rice - in the Spanish style - with a tongue that was great. Of dessert I tried several: the Andean cheese pie, the lúcuma - which is worth the experience to see the beauty of the execution and the incredible taste - and the coconut sorbet. At the end, don’t forget to taste the candy from the “Astrid” box. They're a jewel!

reviews.title: Blown away
reviews.text: Wow wow wow! Food and drinks all incredible & the wait staff were fantastic. We went for our joint 40th and 50th birthday celebration and we adored everything about this place. I think I took more photos here than all of Lima! Super shout out to Frank who was excellent. Thank you for making our birthday so special.

reviews.title: We just checked one off our bucket list and loved it, except for the cost
reviews.text: We did the wonderful tasting menu which lasted about 3 hours and filled us WAY up.  Every bite was delicious and well described by the wonderful and helpful staff.  The room was beautiful as well.  I would not recommend doing the wine pairing; just get a nice bottle of your liking.   Today I got my statement and it was $825 for the 2 of us. The menu is $230 per person and the wine pairing is $190 for very small tastes.

reviews.title: This traditional Limeño restaurant is simply not to be missed!
reviews.text:
Exceptional! A proposal of traditional dishes of Peruvian cuisine with a marked oriental influence, reinvented and with a unique touch. We start with an exquisite Chucuito octopus, followed by oxtail gyozas and chicken dumplings. As a main course, roasted heart gizzards were a real delight. I also tried candied duck and suckling pig; hard to pick a favorite!

Astrid takes care of the desserts, and following their recommendation, we tasted the rum slime with cream (as good as Neapolitan). The atmosphere is extremely pleasant, and they prepare extraordinary piscos.

reviews.title: No mistake
reviews.text: * Astrid & Gaston - super traditional. The restaurant itself is beautiful and large, but several rooms and an elegant decor. The food has no mistake, super tasty entries and the fair price compared with the others. at the entrance we ordered a delicious poke, tiradito and a chicken dumbling. Main dish good and without error: salted lomo very well served. You have to go, especially if it's your first time in Lima.

reviews.title: One of the best restaurants in Lima
reviews.text:
Excellent gastronomy and attention plus very pleasant surroundings. 
Reasonable prices for the chosen restaurant category.

reviews.title: Mandatory
reviews.text: It has met all our expectations. Very nice and welcoming environment, impeccable service, our dishes were excellent. The price, fair for everything they offer, without exaggeration. You have to meet...

reviews.title: Beautiful Restaurant with Great Vibe
reviews.text:
The restaurant is located in a beautiful property with an indoor covered patio where all the action happens. In the patio there is a big beautiful decorated tree where the bar is located. Service was exceptional since we arrived. Food was good but the tacos were specially good. The restaurant is a great place to go as a couple or a big group as it had ample space for all type of groups. 

Make sure to either get there early or stay late to take pictures inside and out of the property. Don’t miss visiting the chapel.

reviews.title: Top-rated restaurant in South America.
reviews.text: We decided to go to Lima to celebrate our anniversary with my girlfriend, choosing this place to go to eat. The truth is, the level of their cuisine and attention is at another level, it is of world quality: starting because they handed us a personalized greeting card of Gaston (one of his owners), following by their exquisite dishes and some incredible desserts. Our garzón Juan attended to us wonderfully, gave us very good recommendations and gave us the idea of sharing 2 different dishes to taste different flavors. If you are in Lima you have to visit this place, fully recommended.

reviews.title: Rename very well justified
reviews.text:
I was at Astrid y Gastón to celebrate my relationship anniversary and the experience was amazing. The environment is beautiful and quite wide, which surprised. The food is delicious and the dishes are very well presented. Also, I didn't find them small, unlike many badass restaurants. We were served by Juan Carlos, who was very hospitable and attentive.

Some dishes can be quite spicy, which makes it interesting to question about it before selecting them (I chose a deep fish Milanese nikei that was very tasty, but a little more spicy than I would like).

In my opinion, desserts and cocktails were what made the experience unforgettable.

The restaurant has a tasting menu and a la carte menu. And it is essential to book in advance.

reviews.title: Very coentro
reviews.text:
Ó place is wonderful... majestic.., the house is beautiful and the different salons with different decorations. The service was perfect from the Reservation to the end... 

Meanwhile the food disappointed me a little... the menu presents dishes with many condiments that we are not used to and as “detest” coentro I had to find one of them without this.. I chose a duck that was good.. my companion chose boyfriend's lomo that for me had too much spice... I couldn't eat..,

The couvert breads are wonderful

reviews.title: Just perfect
reviews.text:
Great experience! The restaurant is located in a great old house in the center of lima.
We had a perfect evening, the lamb was perfectly cooked, as well as the duck. Super ceviche!! A treat

reviews.title: Amazing food , service and design !! You can't go wrong here !!
reviews.text:
It's an experience ! Wonderful design . The service is impeccable as is the food and cocktails . The server gives good recommendation . 
The only thing that was not the top for me was the white wine - no Sauvignon blanc from New Zealand and the ones I tasted (2) were too acidly and not fruity - but that's just me

reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: Beautiful experience from the entrance to the restaurant, everything perfect, celebrate my birthday in this place and I can not be more than satisfied. However, it had its shortcomings, I am a smoker and every time I went to smoke on the terrace no one took care of taking out my ashes, and for a change I added a plate that I had cancelled. That kind of thing in a restaurant like that shouldn't happen. But hey, there's room for improvement.
reviews.review_tip: Desde chile lleven el vino, el primer descorche es gratis

reviews.title: Gastronomy experience
reviews.text:
Beautiful site and high standard food, well prepared and well presented.
Modern Peruvian cuisine.
It is a must when visiting Lima.

reviews.title: I loved it. Enchanted.
reviews.text:
We had a very good experience. We book with 3 days in advance for lunch. The entrance is very charming, but the attendant who guided us to the table needs to improve their approach. The waiter who served us was wonderful, the dishes tasty, well presented, the Astrid very welcoming and friendly. 
The environment is charming and the ambient music is pleasant.

reviews.title: Experience in Astrid Restaurant and Gaston Lima Peru.
reviews.text: Extraordinary culinary experience of fusion food that mixes the flavors and inspiration of Peruvian culture with its influences of native peoples with immigrants. Very pleasant and carefully decorated atmosphere.
reviews.review_tip: Se sugiere realizar reserva con tiempo previo a viaje (2 meses mínimo).

reviews.title: Amazing place and delicious food!
reviews.text: Amazing place with delicious food. Staff was impressive for the attention. It was my wedding anniversary and they really took care of us. Peruvian food with their own signature… really impressive.

reviews.title: Deliver what you promise!
reviews.text:
I was in September 2025 with a group of friends. The Reservation was super punctual. The exceptional food! Nice environment! 
I recommend.

reviews.title: Unmissable on a visit to Lima
reviews.text: Restaurant that impresses by its beauty and offers excellent dishes! I suggest visitors to opt for the Menu a la carte and try the numerous delicacies of the menu at a more affordable price.

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: Really an exceptional meal. Excellent dishes, great wine and fantastic pairing and an overall unforgettable experience

reviews.title: Wonderful.
reviews.text: He's one of those forced in Lima. Not much to add, all rich, cute, friendly. Hedgehog ceviche is a sea bite. Artichoke tiger milk has a unique creaminess. Unbeatable service. The decor of the place is a carnival. Don't miss it.

reviews.title: Lima can do top cuisine 😊
reviews.text: After our all in all very sobering evening at Central we didn't want to end the trip like this and went to the Astrid & Gaston at the end - what a culinary highlight. In a wonderful Villa best food, best service and the wine list holds the best grapes from all over the world. The courtyard is beautiful, but also the tables within the Villa always recommended, each room its own story. Tip: The starters are incredibly good, here a wide selection is worth it - but beware: The main courses are just as grand and the portions sumptuous, so unfortunately no dessert fit with us, which was also the only drawback. On the next trip to Lima the Astrid is a definite must 😊😊😊

reviews.title: Quality food and care 😋
reviews.text: The attention is super personalized, and the food is a blast for the 10/10 palate. The atmosphere also shows well thinking, with its yunsesco trees 😋 The only thing that is expected a bit to be assigned a table, even with Reservation

reviews.title: Elegant restaurant.
reviews.text:
This restaurant in Lima is very elegant, always busy and should be booked.
We went as a couple without Reservation, the lobby people did not want to receive us but then another employee allowed us to enter and we were located in the bar and there we ate very tasty.
You have a very nice time.
The food is delicious and the attentions excellent.
There's a souvenir shop.

reviews.title: Wonderful experience.
reviews.text: Fine Peruvian dining in a setting bursting with charm and character.  The service was professional and attentive.   The restaurant was very accommodating to our daughter with celiacs - the waiters were knowledgeable about what dishes were (or could be adapted to be) gluten free and also put our minds at rest about cross contamination risk.  All in their faultless English.  Even the gluten free bread basket was first class.  There was so much on the menu we wanted to try.  The main course portions were all very generous -.the duck rice, lamb ravioli and the lomo saltado all got the thumbs up.  A magnificent night out.

reviews.title: Expensive but worth it!
reviews.text: I ate the experience menu. Dear? Yeah, the most expensive food I've ever paid in my life. Is it worth it? Valeu! Seriously, everything very perfect and explosions of flavors from beginning to end.
reviews.review_tip: Não se engane, seu refil de água está sendo cobrado. O chazinho ou café no final também hahahaa

reviews.title: Horrible experience at a place that was highly anticipated
reviews.text:
We had a horrible experience there! The gas stove was not working and this resulted in our waiter bringing in all kinds of cold appetizers that we didn’t order. We thought it was the restaurant’s way of apologizing for their very limited menu. It turned up it was on our own dine and was super duper expensive! My daughter, who doesn’t like seafood, had wanted to order a $20 pasta. Instead, she had to order one of the 3 meals they had available which was a steak for almost $70!
Honestly, I understand that accidents happen but the least they could have done would have been to give a discount or offer a few appetizers for free! Also, we were there to celebrate a big birthday and they didn’t even bring in a candle or desserts!!! How cheap can they be? I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant to anyone! Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Excellent experience but...
reviews.text: I first went to this restaurant and mentioned that it was a very pleasant experience, the exquisite food and the unbeatable atmosphere; and my family and I really enjoyed Mrs. Astrid's timing, kindness and detail of greeting each of the tables.  Really an experience to enjoy.  I'll be back on my next trip to Lima.  One thing to improve, the presentation of the staff, very sloppy... wrinkled shirts and white percussion, dirty shoes, some with cuffs rolled up, do not give appearance of neatness.

reviews.title: Unforgettable dinner, all excellent.
reviews.text: Very pleasant place, beautiful facilities, very good food and excellent care, their staff demonstrate great knowledge of the meals and can guide very well on which dish to choose

reviews.title: Best restaurant in Lima😍
reviews.text: 13th best restaurant in Lima with reason because it was the best restaurant of our trip in Peru,with an impeccable decoration the Astrid has a very good food with a great service and waiters who spoke Portuguese,simply PERFECT ⁇

reviews.title: disappointment
reviews.text: Malisimo. Impressive how long it takes to bring the food. We had to order the missing dishes several times. Desserts took more than an hour. The ballot like 25 minutes. Disaster. Food is for not coming back

reviews.title: Menu Tasting
reviews.text:
The place by itself is already imposing. 
We opted for the tasting menu which was simply fantastic. 
The dishes were super elaborate and presented visual perfection. Astrid passed through our table to thank you, being extremely friendly and welcoming. The chocolates at the end closed the night with a golden key.

reviews.title: Wonderful food
reviews.text:
Exceptional place where I tried the tasting menu with harmonization of drinks.
11 salty dishes and 3 sweets + chocolates were served.
A wonderful experience, as it is always a box of surprises.

The only point is the price - but it is worth the experience.

reviews.title: Great family get together.
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, Astrid came to our table to greet us, Pisco sour was very good, I ate the duck and it was delicious.
The bathroom a little far and lots of stairs.

reviews.title: a must go
reviews.text: We were surprised by the decoration so original and different. Even more surprised when our pisco drinks came. Absolutely delicious. We ordered rice with seafood.  The best I have eaten. It comes with a cream that blends in your mouth. Apart from that all waiaters were cordial and Astrid came to each table to greet the guests.  Actually we didn't pay that much for that quality restaurante.

reviews.title: Pleasant experience
reviews.text:
A very nice place, the service is very good, all the staff are very attentive, the waiters know the menu well.  The food arrived after a short waiting time at a good temperature and a great presentation.  The taste?  Very good!!  I ordered a Thousand Leafs potato "Heart" and strong dish the Duck candied five flavors.  The portions are enough and leave "a little hole" for dessert that I recommend not to miss, they are very good!!  I ordered tiramisu and I don't disappoint at all! I'm sure I'll be back on my next visit to Lima.
Speaking of the price, it is very much in line with the quality of the dishes and worth it.

reviews.title: Hotels in Lima
reviews.text:
On our last night on this holiday in Lima we had Reservation at ASTRID & GASTÓN.
Restaurant of the important Peruvian chef Gastón Acurio.
Restaurant is located in a 18th-century mansion in the San Isidro district.
We arrived just before the scheduled time and were accommodated in a waiting area on a comfortable couch, where we stayed for less than ten minutes, we were led to a vibrant courtyard where our table lay.
Perfect service. Do not fail to try the couvert, bread baskets made with local ingredients and accompanying. 
Dishes executed with perfection and great drinks. 
We don't just like the suggested dessert.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text:
Visited Astrid y Gaston for lunch and had a great time.
Love the atmosphere of the restaurant, in particular the patio where most of the sitting is.
The food was delicious and the portions very generous, we definitely did not leave hungry.

reviews.title: Dated. Was not worth it
reviews.text: Astrid y Gaston is a bit dated and the food was pretty uninspired.  Everything just felt so so and would not go out of your way for. Also expensive.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
We were disappointed with the restaurant. In the reservation I had already said that I did not like coentro, the waiter asked us about food restrictions and I made it very clear that I did not like coentro. In my two plates they filled with coentro. Of the 4 dishes we ordered, only one of them we found really tasty, which was a thousand leaves of potatoes with chicken heart. The ceviche was okay. The lamb squirrel (suggestion from the waiter) was the worst disappointment of the night. A tasteless rice, along with a bean vinagret that only tasted corn and lamb without spice. Mass to vongole just ok tbm. 
Chef had the kindness of sending a dessert because I had not liked the dish.  It was a replay of tiramissu with local ingredients that was quite tasty. 
On average I would give a 5/10 score for dinner. We ⁇ 't come back and ⁇ 't recommend the restaurant.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Disappointing. Even warning food restrictions, the food came as if we hadn't warned. Food without much taste, ceviche ok, a lot of acid. Ossobuco we left most, meat without spices, rice without taste, a lot of coenter in everything (even warning that we did not like it). Waiter was quite careless (few waiters for the amount of customers). Do not recommend and would not come back.

reviews.title: Imperdoavel.
reviews.text: Our reservation was made for 15.15h and when we sat down we were not given the opportunity to choose the dishes with peace. Shortly after serving the entrance, the waiter withdrew it warning us that he would bring the main dish, because the kitchen would close at 16h.

reviews.title: Excellent food experience  ⁇ 🇪
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience. A cozy atmosphere, really good service and delicious food, which is a fusion of a lot of different cultures. We will definitely come back  ⁇ 🇪

reviews.title: Incredible Dinner Tasting!! Super recommend!
reviews.text: A long-awaited experience! The refinement of the presentation of the dishes, combined with the taste and perfect combination of the high local cuisine with the contemporary, made the dinner tasting, the realization of an immense curiosity and desire realized! Astrid&Gaston is fantastic! And being able to talk to Astrid was too much! Super recommend!

reviews.title: Great gastronomic experience
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant, with many options on the menu. Creative use of local ingredients. High point: tomato ceviche. Great dishes: lomo de novillo and Wellington del mar.

reviews.title: Caveat Emptor
reviews.text:
Interesting culinary experience ruined by this venue's unsavory policy of offering a tasting menu without saying the number of dishes (15!) nor the price of the meal, only to stiff the patron at the end with an offer they can't refuse.
Caveat emptor.
reviews.review_tip: Ask for prices before you order.

reviews.title: Outstanding evening with friends
reviews.text: What a treat!  A beautifully decorated and classy establishment in Lima.  From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and at home.  The interior is exquisite and service impeccable.  The owner, Astrid, even stopped by to say hello.  We look forward to dining here again!

reviews.title: Great fine dining experience in Lima
reviews.text: Wonderful restaurant with excellent service, great vibes, and delicious food. We even got to meet and chat with the owner, Astrid!

reviews.title: Woooow a great experience!!
reviews.text:
Magical place, beautiful decoration, mansion with history, Peruvian fusion food, special attention, in a good area of Peru. 
We share different dishes with very special flavors. The duck and legado deli.
reviews.review_tip:
Solicitar reserva con tiempo.
Tiene parqueadero.
Los valores altos pero la experiencia fue especial.

reviews.title: Top notch experience
reviews.text: Excellent tasting menu with a perfect wine pairing experience. All the menu items were full of complex and complimenting flavors with outstanding presentation. The wait staff was extremely attentive and knowledgeable. The dining room ambiance was highly classy as well. We spent 4 hours enjoying a he meal and were delighted with a personal visit from Astrid herself.

reviews.title: A gastronomic gem in Lima
reviews.text: In a beautiful colonial-style house and in one of the best areas of Lima is this gastronomic gem. The entire menu is spectacular for its combination of flavors, but my favorite was, in the strong ones, the sole.

reviews.title: Food good service needs work
reviews.text:
The food was nicely prepared and presented. Sommelier was very difficult to understand it felt like they really overcharged me, a tourist, on the wine. When I questioned it on the bill the server rushed away with the check and then came back with an explanation that I didn’t trust. 
Servers kind of hovered and I always felt they were watching me - uncomfortable!
Also it took a long long time to get the check. Seemed like our server ignored me

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Great restaurant! All dishes were great. We were served by Luiz, who was very attentive, explaining the dishes with great patience.

reviews.title: Mini tasting menu
reviews.text: We did a mini tasting recommended by the helpful Aníbal, everything was perfect. Astrid went around the room and talked to everyone.

reviews.title: A good night in Lima
reviews.text:
Pleasant environment. Astrid herself attended to me and recommended dessert.
You spend a lot of money on one night, but it's worth the experience.

reviews.title: Bad experience, they took too long and it was not what we expected
reviews.text: Terrible, they took 52 minutes to serve us, we asked for 3/4 of the meat and they brought it to us half finished, we had to wait again, I don't recommend it

reviews.title: Great misplaced expectations.
reviews.text: Obviously each review must be considered based on the level of the structure being reviewed. Of course the food at Astrid and Gaston's is not to be thrown away. But we are still talking about one that claims to be among the best restaurants in all of South America. So expectations were very high, considering that in Lima we ate well and sometimes very well in other restaurants. Primarily. The place? Fabulous, elegant, refined; a postcard of Peru with its best aspects enclosed in a building with a beautiful internal courtyard, between colonial and neo-classical. Not an item out of place. Nothing to say. Already high expectations become very high. Appropriate welcome, kind but not affected. Bread basket top to say the least. so far everything perfect. We start the dinner with some "piqueos"; not being particularly hungry we choose to skip the entrees and then move directly to the main course. The piqueos were good, yes, but nothing that made us say WOW, as elsewhere (Merit for example) they delighted us with every course. The main dishes. Fabulous beef for the quality of the meat. A dish with little inventiveness but good. My rice with duck: a lump of rice made into a single body with vegetables on which 4 slices of duck breast were placed. A dish that was poorly cooked for me and personally, no one at the table liked it. Finally, the rice with marisco is not unpleasant in taste but in the long run it turns out to be cloying, heavy, and only three of us were able to finish it. For what this place represents in the Lima restaurant scene, it's a definite no. In the end. The service turns off as the dinner continues, leaving the plates for a good half hour before coming to remove them and asking if we wanted a dessert that we didn't take. No question about the fact that, except for one, the dishes were returned to the obvious dissatisfaction of the customer. You expect it from a restaurant like this. High cost, in our opinion not deserved. I would recommend it just for the location, really beautiful.

reviews.title: The best! Astrid & Gastón Restaurant
reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience, we were able to get a reservation a few days in advance, from the reception, the accompaniment, the waiter. He was a very cultured and kind man, very good recommendations, the FOOD was excellent!!! And the best surprise!! Astrid was there and took a beautiful photo with us.

reviews.title: Break of expectation
reviews.text:
Very average experience, we expected more and were frustrated.
The dishes were delicious, but nothing special either.
The ceviche was bland compared to the one at the Cala restaurant.
The service left a lot to be desired, we felt pressured and unwelcome.

The highlight is the decoration, which is breathtaking.

reviews.title: Foodie heaven
reviews.text: Astrid y Gaston is fabulous. I'm a foodie and dine at Michelin restaurants a lot. Astrid y Gaston tasting menu is right up there except that you can get a reservation a few days in advance. I went with two friends who aren't quite as foodie as me and they were totally sold on the meal. Every course was amazing. I particularly liked the scallops in a fresh chilled tomato broth with lime juice, but the guinea pig was very good and about a dozen other courses. Not to mention the desserts and the magic chocolate box where you really good eat as many excellent chocolates as you wanted. Plus, you are dining in a large old house. The wait staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive.  And the price was quite reasonable for the quality and quantity.
reviews.review_tip: The tasting menu is a foodie experience. You can try so many wonderful tastes for a very reasonable price.

reviews.title: Mega recommended!
reviews.text:
The place is INCREDIBLE.
The drinks and food were unbeatable, all very tasty and very rich. Excellently presented.
The attention could be better...the rest WITHOUT WORDS
The wonderful ceviche, delicious sea bass loin, Wellington del Mar and Rice with Seafood were the favorites

reviews.title: A culinary Gem
reviews.text:
From the moment we stepped into the restaurant, the experience was nothing short of spectacular. The service was impeccable with wait staff that were not only friendly but exceptionally knowledgeable about the menu, eloquently explaining the fusion of various global influences with traditional Peruvian cuisine. Each dish served was a testament to the quality and creativity of the kitchen, seamlessly blending different cultural elements into classic recipes.

The atmosphere of the restaurant added to the overall charm, making it an ideal spot for both families and couples looking for a memorable dining experience. The outdoor area deserves a special mention as it provided a picturesque setting perfect for photography enthusiasts wanting to capture beautiful moments.

However, there were a couple of issues that detracted from the otherwise stellar evening. There was noticeable noise bleeding from a neighboring room, likely due to a business party, which at times disrupted the ambiance. Additionally, the occasional waft of cigarette smoke each time the door opened was slightly off-putting.

Despite these minor setbacks, the restaurant delivers an exceptional dining experience with its innovative approach to Peruvian cuisine and a delightful setting. It's a must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in culinary excellence while enjoying a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: A great place with a good atmosphere with the bar in the middle of very good dessert and aperitif dishes, very friendly staff

reviews.title: From my favorites!
reviews.text: One of my favorite restaurants in Lima, returning is always a pleasure. Carlos made our night a spectacular experience! My must-haves: the lomo saltado, the razor clams, the guinea pig!!!
